question: In post-independent India, the first elected Parliament came into existence in ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**April 1952.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **first general elections** in independent India were held in **1951-52.**
 
• The **first elected Parliament** came into existence on **April 17, 1952.**
 
• The Parliament consisted of two houses - the **Council of States** (Rajya Sabha) and the **House of the People** (Lok Sabha).
 
• The Constitution of India came into force on **January 26, 1950**, but the first Parliament was formed only after the general elections were held in 1951-52.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Following India's first general election, on April 17, 1952, the **First Lok Sabha** was established.
 
• The 1st Lok Sabha was** dissolved **on** April 4, 1957**, having served its whole five-year term.
 
• On **May 13, 1952**, the First Session of this Lok Sabha convened.
 
• There were** 489 Lok Sabha seats** in all, and 17.3 crore people were entitled to vote.
